question: Three cubes each having volume 1728 cm³ are placed one above the other. What is the total surface area of the resulting solid?
solution:
**Given:**

The total number of cubes = 3

The volume of each cube = 1728 cm3

**Formula used:**

The volume of cube = (side)³

The surface area of a cuboid = 2 (wl + hl + hw)

Where, h = Height; w = Width; and l = Length

**Calculation:**

Let, the radius of each cube = a

So, a³ = 1728

⇒ a3 = 12³

⇒ a = 12

∴ The radius of each cube = 12 cm

After placing one cube above the other, it will look like,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11c67610f92e123fe6d59e8e78d85969e3c9b340b80d9ff5ee12de30b4eb5eb7.png] 

In this solid, height = (12 + 12 + 12) = 36 cm

Width = 12 cm and Length = 12 cm

∴ The surface area = 2 [(12 × 12) + (36 × 12) + (36 × 12)]

= 2 × 12 (12 + 36 + 36)

= 24 × 84

= 2016 cm2

**∴ The total surface area of the resulting solid is 2016 cm2**
